title: Anyone can set the protocol fee
root_cause: setProtocolFeeBps has no access control; the admin-only intent is documented but not enforced.
impact: An attacker can set the fee to 100% of every sale, capturing all seller proceeds on subsequent sales.
recommendation: Store an admin address and require msg.sender == admin (or an owner role) in setProtocolFeeBps.

title: Signed offers can be filled repeatedly
root_cause: The offer digest contains no nonce, and the filled mapping is never checked or written, so a valid signature authorizes unlimited fills.
impact: A maker's signed offer can be replayed by repeatedly filling it, draining the maker's payment token balance.
recommendation: Include a unique offer id/nonce and the contract address in the digest, mark the offer as filled before transfers, and reject already-filled offers.

title: Buyer overpayments are stuck in the contract
root_cause: buy requires msg.value >= price but only forwards listing.price; the excess is neither refunded nor withdrawable.
impact: Any buyer who overpays permanently loses the excess ETH to the contract.
recommendation: Require msg.value == price, or refund msg.value - listing.price to the buyer in the same transaction.
